title: RFC 5536 article header format conformance
description:
Validate that articles stored and retrieved by the reader conform to RFC 5536 (Netnews Article Format): mandatory headers present (From, Date, Message-ID, Newsgroups, Subject, Path), header field syntax valid, body is valid UTF-8 text. Use a Python validator script against retrieved articles. Artifact: tests/conformance/rfc5536_headers.py.

Acceptance criteria:
- All 6 mandatory RFC 5536 headers present in every retrieved article
- Date: value parseable by Python email.utils.parsedate_to_datetime
- Message-ID: matches <local@domain> pattern
- Path: contains at least one element
- Body is valid UTF-8
- At least 20 test articles validated
